page.layout: Running head across the top, with the page number at top right. One column of running text below. Bottom line with a gathering mark at the lower right. No marginal notes. Left edge shows stains only.

main_text.p: missa. Sed vix elapso decennio, parta à Conone victoria navali ad Cnidum, imperioque maris Atheniensibus restituto, rediit ipsa quoque ad societatem Atheniensium: ac rursum à quadriennio cum Rhodiis & vicinis aliis Lacedaemoniorum partibus se reddidit, fortunam eorum, qui plus poterant, sequens. Iterum vero cum in potestatem Tigranis Persæ regii præfecti forte venisset, isque præsidium ei imposuisset, à Timotheo Cononis filio duce Attico cum classe illuc delato obsessa, & dejecto præsidio libertati reddita fuit. Nec quicquam præterea in rebus Samiorum apud historiographos veteres memorabile: videturque post id tempus fortuna urbis hujus sensim decrevisse, & mediocris omnino ad sæculum primorum Cæsarum Romanorum pervenisse. Siquidem & libertate à Cæsare Augusto donata fuit, & cum civibus abundaret, pascendi pecoris ergo non parvam eorum multitudinem Strabonis ævo in Icariam tum indigenis infrequentem emisit, ut idem Strabo nos docet.

page.notes: The text is in a long s font. Here it is written as a plain s, per the rules. The printed "ss" and "ff" forms in "imposuisset" and "venisset" are copied as "impofuisset" and "venisset". The top word "missa." is a fragment from the previous page, printed as "missa." at the start of the page. The bottom line reads "14" at centre-left and "X.DE" at right. I have taken "X.DE" as the gathering mark. Its exact form is slightly doubtful. The left edge is stained and shows some show-through, which is not transcribed.
